corr.cappedTip: Atlas caps a verdict at Weakly supports when fewer than 20 cases back it.

corr.changedOtherTip: Atlas changed this verdict because the evidence didn’t meet its rules.

corr.gappedTip: Atlas doesn’t accept a backtest claim on data with an unrepaired gap.
